name: Code Context Engine
shrinks: file reads through semantic code search and intelligent indexing
about: MCP server that indexes the codebase locally and returns only relevant code functions and snippets instead of whole file reads.

setup.command: claude mcp add --scope user code-context-engine -- code-context-engine
setup.purpose: Register Code Context Engine MCP server with Claude Code

teardown.purpose: Unregister Code Context Engine from Claude Code
